fields.acceptance: A testscript resumes a ship-change-shaped run interrupted after its land step on a landed change set and it goes on past its stopped step to succeed; in the same suite run-resume-unaccepted.txtar keeps passing (a build run on a landed change set and runs on withdrawn or rejected change sets are refused with exit 3 naming rhiza run abandon, each journal unchanged)
fields.statement: rhiza run resume continues an unfinished non-plan run whose change set has landed when its journal shows the run reached its land step (land entered or passed), going on from where the journal left it; a non-plan run on a landed change set that never reached land is still refused as no longer accepted, naming rhiza run abandon

fields.acceptance: A unit test of daemon.Resumable returns an interrupted run on a landed change set whose journal entered land, and not one on a landed change set whose journal never reached land, nor runs on rejected, withdrawn, proposed or draft change sets; daemon-resume.txtar gains a run interrupted after land on a landed change set that gets one daemon-resumed entry
fields.statement: The daemon resumes, once and headless, an interrupted non-plan run whose change set has landed when its journal shows the run reached its land step, as it resumes a run on an accepted change set

fields.acceptance: A test with an interrupted run on a landed change set that reached land shows no skipped item for it in rhiza inbox --json, while an interrupted build run on a landed change set that never reached land is still listed as skipped with rhiza run abandon
fields.statement: rhiza inbox does not list as skipped an interrupted non-plan run on a landed change set whose journal reached its land step, since the daemon resumes it; such a run interrupted again after the daemon's resume is listed as gave-up as any other

set.statement: The daemon resumes an interrupted run only while its change set is accepted, or, for a non-plan run that reached its land step, landed (daemon-resumes-landed-past-land)

rhiza run resume refuses an interrupted run whose change set is no longer accepted, naming the state and rhiza run abandon; a plan-workflow run whose change set has landed (plan-run-resumes-landed-record) and a non-plan run on a landed change set that reached its land step (run-resume-landed-past-land) are the exceptions

`genesis run resume <run>` continues a stopped run from its journal without a daemon, never redoing a finished step; it refuses an interrupted run whose change set has landed, been rejected, withdrawn or superseded, except that a run whose change set has landed is resumed when it is a plan-workflow run (plan-run-resumes-landed-record) or reached its land step (run-resume-landed-past-land).
